scope: Parallel LG M50T arrangements of 1 to 4 cells against the Raspberry Pi 5 gateway backup and a 12 A stress test. Simulation with published same-cell-type tables. Not hardware validation.

options.baseline: Same-end outputs and 0.08 mm copper links
options.opposite: Negative output moved to the far cell, return route lengthened
options.combined: Thicker links and the opposite-end output together

position_mismatch.applies_to: Every cell position in turn, both signs, every option, both missions

combined_samples.note: All cells vary at once: capacity 5%, R0 and RC 10%, OCV 25 mV, charge 2 points, contact factor 1 to 2. These are sensitivity samples, not a population or a probability.

a_case_passes_only_if: The product does not refuse it
No cell reaches an operating limit or the edge of model coverage
Battery voltage stays at or above 3.3 V
Temperature is calculated and the first-law check closes
qualification.reported_only: Combined samples and the 12 A stress test. They are the Honest Finding, not a pass or fail gate.
qualification.ranking: Compare qualifying designs on cell count, listed cell cost, cell mass and operating margins. Never rank on delivered Wh, because holding current constant lets higher-voltage designs deliver more without serving the Pi any better.
qualification.claim: Smallest qualifying design among the parallel arrangements tested
